mentions.name: pptx-tools
mentions.description: A collection of CLI tools for interacting with PowerPoint presentations, covering use cases PowerPoint doesn't support. Includes pptx-grep to find text across multiple presentations (yielding file, slide number, and match excerpt), pptx-dump to dump extended info such as slide count, applied master slides, and used fonts, and pptx-lint to define validation rules for presentations based on content and formatting (e.g. forbidden words or required fonts).
